_meta.description: 400+ verified cultural, behavioral and socioeconomic data points for Norway. Covers daily routines (friluftsliv!), spending (oil fund), social norms (Janteloven, high trust), business culture (37hr week, generous leave), religion (high secularism), digital behavior (e-government #1 globally, Vipps), education, housing (82% ownership!), food & lifestyle, trust & governance, and regional variations.
